about: What was said about the summit's future, kept as it was said, beside what happened (Dinis, 19 November 2026, about 01:22 UTC: every prediction kept and checked; drawn after designer@'s board/spec-past-and-forecast.md, PF5, PF7 and PF8). Entries are never overwritten: a correction is a new entry. Each rests on catalogued items, by id.
source: Web Summit (the organiser), its public statements as catalogued; linked only, never read by machine

predictions.said: Day Two, Wednesday 11 November, will not take place (on the Portuguese Government's formal advice, Storm Charles).
predictions.happened: Day Two did not take place: no replay exists, and the press reported a cancelled Wednesday.

predictions.said: The summit is officially back on Thursday 12 November for its final day.
predictions.happened: Day Three took place: Web Summit published its replay on its YouTube channel.

predictions.said: Stage talks start at 9am on Thursday 12 November.
predictions.gap: No source read for when Thursday's talks began: the replays carry no chapters or start times. Shown as a gap until one is found.
